name: Che's Surf and Snorkel
summary: A small, locally owned outfit run by surfer Ché Allan from a shop at Drill Hall Beach. It runs semi private catamaran trips to snorkel with sea turtles and over shipwrecks, and gives surf lessons for beginners and improving surfers.
standouts: Founder Ché Allan has surfed since age 6 and placed 5th at the WSL world junior championship at 17
Snorkel guide Che is certified in water rescue
Small semi private snorkel tour with underwater GoPro photos included

trips.title: Snorkel with turtles
trips.summary: A small, semi private catamaran trip that picks you up, boards from the beach and heads out to snorkel with sea turtles. The boat then sails to the shipwrecks or a coral reef to see tropical fish, with Che guiding and sharing the history of the wrecks.
highlights: Sail on to the shipwrecks or a coral reef
Free transport within the transportation zone
trips.requirements: Must be able to swim and climb the boat's boarding ladder
trips.checkNotes: The 'Click Here to Book' button goes to a Tripadvisor product page (marketplace, not recorded); otherwise WhatsApp or email. Departure beach and times not stated; the site says guests are picked up and board from the beach. The site notes turtles are wild and sightings cannot be guaranteed. No turtle feeding is advertised.

trips.title: Surf Lessons
trips.summary: Surf lessons for all levels, from first waves to coaching for more experienced surfers. Lessons are based at Drill Hall Beach and sometimes move to another break depending on the day's wave report.
highlights: Run by Ché Allan, a former WSL world junior championship competitor
Based at Drill Hall Beach, with other breaks used to suit the waves and your level
trips.checkNotes: No price or lesson length on the site. The 'Book Here' button goes to a Tripadvisor attraction page (marketplace, not recorded); otherwise WhatsApp.

checkNotes: The list names this operator Shaka Catamaran; the site's header and copyright use Che's Surf and Snorkel and Che's Surf Lessons, and only the logo file name says shaka.
